post.description: Authorization order: BP-01 membership; load catalog (unavailable/malformed503); missing route action gives403 for list/create/mutation or404 for detail/ACL/hold GET before lookup; missing document/no ACL ALLOW/explicit DENY404; stale revision409 only after authorization. Self-revoked ACL replay404. Route action: document.create.
